name: fetch_policy
description: Read the policy assigned to this authenticated synthetic intake session. No coverage guarantee.

name: create_claim_draft
description: Save or update the customer's synthetic accident draft. Send all currently known fields. Null means unknown. Returns claimId and version; does not submit.

incidentAt.description: ISO 8601 date/time with an explicit offset, or null if not known. Clarify timezone before submission.

description.description: Customer narrative in their own words, or null.

injuryStatus.description: What the customer reported about injuries.

otherPartyInvolved.description: Whether another vehicle was reported, or null.

policeReportNumber.description: Synthetic report reference if supplied, otherwise null.

name: submit_accident_report
description: Submit the latest saved draft ONLY after reading it back and receiving explicit customer confirmation. Use the latest saved version. Investigation runs asynchronously.
